article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (SOE Super Fan Days)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing the Super Fan Days promotion, running Wednesday 2010-11-03 through Tuesday 2010-11-09. It covers a 50% Station Cash discount on purchases of 2000+ Station Cash and rotating one-day item sales across several SOE games, including Free Realms. The post is one of several SOE games' promotions and does not name the specific Free Realms items on sale.

article_summaries.title: SOE Super Fan Days Details
article_summaries.summary: SOE's Super Fan Days promotion ran for seven days in November (item-of-the-day deals November 3 to 9, per the article) with a 50% discount on online Station Cash purchases of 2,000 or more. The page is a Spanish-language freerealms.com news page whose body is in English; it gives no item names, so the specific sale items are not recorded here.

article_summaries.title: SOE Super Fan Days
article_summaries.summary: A SOE-wide promotion announced on the Free Realms news page: Super Fan Days ran November 3-9, 2010, offering 50% off Station Cash purchases of 2000 Station Cash or more, plus one-day item sales each day in several SOE games including Free Realms. The page is dated only as 'posted 3 weeks, 3 days ago' relative to the November 2010 capture, so the posting date is inferred, not stated.

article_summaries.title: SOE Super Fan Days
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing Super Fan Days, a sale running from Wednesday 3 November 2010 to Tuesday 9 November 2010 across several SOE games including Free Realms. For Free Realms it describes a daily one-day sale on one selected item and a 50% discount on select Station Cash purchases of 2000 or more. The post is multi-game and gives no Free Realms-specific item names or prices.
